ingest.note: Input audio must be sent as audio/pcm;rate=16000 (16 kHz 16-bit little-endian PCM mono). 8 kHz or μ-law is rejected or produces garbage.

egress.note: Output audio is 24 kHz 16-bit PCM mono (inline_data, audio/L16). Must be resampled to the telephony rate and encoded before sending back to a PSTN caller.

potholes.note: Gemini Live ingests 16 kHz PCM (audio/pcm;rate=16000). Feeding it 8 kHz μ-law telephony audio without decoding + resampling produces silent or corrupted turns.
Output is 24 kHz PCM. Sending raw 24 kHz frames to an 8 kHz μ-law telephony leg without resample + encode corrupts playback.
send_realtime_input triggers model response automatically via server-side VAD; you do not manually commit turns in the optimized path. Coordinate turn logic with this.

A system instruction can define the opening but does not itself start a turn. For agent-first calls, wait for confirmed carrier answer/media start, then send one short in-conversation text instruction with send_realtime_input(text=...). On gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview, send_client_content is for seeding initial history, not this live startup turn. Do not inject fake caller audio or wait for caller VAD.
On barge-in, Gemini emits interruption_detected; stop playing queued output audio and flush the outbound buffer, else the caller hears overlapping speech.
Input and output sample rates differ (16k in, 24k out). Build two independent resamplers; do not reuse one for both directions.

Live API sessions are time-limited (minutes-scale with audio; verify the current limit in docs before shipping). For calls longer than the limit use session resumption (session_handle) and context-window compression; a naive reconnect loses conversation state mid-call.

latency_evidence.methodology: Callsmith architecture-budget placeholder; benchmark in the deployment region before setting an SLO.

interruption.description: Gemini Live has built-in server-side VAD. On user interrupt, the server emits interruption_detected. Stop playing queued output and flush the outbound buffer immediately.
interruption.code_hint: On 'interruption_detected' event: (1) stop audio playback, (2) flush outbound queue, (3) resume listening.

deployment.self_host_notes: API service — nothing to self-host. Co-locate your worker with the model serving region and verify data-residency options for regulated deployments; long calls need session resumption design (see session_duration_limit pothole).
